name: tracefy-monorepo
description: Local-first context-aware debugging across VS Code, terminal, browser, and code.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tracefy/protocol && npm run build -w @tracefy/core && npm run build -w @tracefy/ai && npm run build -w @tracefy/mcp && npm run build -w tracefy && npm run build -w @tracefy/chrome-extension
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tracefy/core && npm run test -w @tracefy/ai && npm run test -w @tracefy/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tracefy/protocol && npm run build -w @tracefy/core && npm run build -w @tracefy/ai && npm run build -w @tracefy/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @tracefy/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @tracefy/core && npm run typecheck -w @tracefy/ai && npm run typecheck -w @tracefy/mcp && npm run typecheck -w tracefy && npm run typecheck -w @tracefy/chrome-extension
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build && npm run package -w tracefy
scripts.package:release: npm run build && npm run package -w tracefy && npm run package:chrome
